# Generated Command Inventory

> Generated by `npm run generate:command-docs`. Do not edit directly.

This file is built from stable MCP tool definitions, Unity Bridge `[McpCommand]` descriptors, and Gateway virtual command descriptors. Feature-gated commands are implemented but hidden until the matching config flag is enabled.

## Stable MCP Tools

| Tool | Status | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sgg_unity_projects` | Implemented | List live Unity projects plus aggregate live/stale registry counts. |
| `sgg_unity_stale_projects` | Implemented | Query bounded, filterable stale heartbeat history with stable cursor pagination. |
| `sgg_unity_stale_registry_cleanup` | Implemented | Preview or explicitly clean bounded expired stale heartbeat records owned by confirmed-dead processes. |
| `sgg_unity_describe` | Implemented | Read project status, command catalog, grouped command lists, or one command schema. |
| `sgg_unity_call` | Implemented | Invoke one Unity command for an explicit project. |
| `sgg_unity_batch` | Implemented | Run bounded batches of Unity command calls with explicit project per item. |
| `sgg_unity_job` | Implemented | Poll gateway-local jobs and request cancellation only for commands that advertise `supports_cancel`. |
| `sgg_unity_logs` | Implemented | Read bounded gateway, bridge, or Unity log tails. |

| `policy.explain` | Feature-gated | `sgg_mcp_policy` | read | Explain feature, visibility, and policy outcomes for a command without executing it or consuming approvals. |
| `skill.import` | Feature-gated | `sgg_mcp_skills` | write | Copy a discovered skill into .mcp/skills/<target_name>/ for manual review without granting permissions. |
| `skill.list` | Feature-gated | `sgg_mcp_skills` | read | List bounded local, Unity-style, and built-in example skills with validation and review metadata. |
| `skill.read` | Feature-gated | `sgg_mcp_skills` | read | Read bounded SKILL.md or resource content by safe skill name from a fixed skill root. |
| `skill.validate` | Feature-gated | `sgg_mcp_skills` | read | Validate a SKILL.md without executing instructions or modifying files. |
| `unity.docs.index.clear` | Feature-gated | `unity_docs_local` | destructive | Delete only the fixed project-local Unity docs cache files, dry-run-first and without touching source docs. |
| `unity.docs.index.rebuild` | Feature-gated | `unity_docs_local` | write | Build a bounded project-local Unity docs cache from approved local docs roots only, dry-run-first and without network access. |
| `unity.docs.index.status` | Feature-gated | `unity_docs_local` | read | Report fixed project-local Unity docs cache status without scanning docs or fetching network documentation. |
| `unity.docs.open_reference` | Feature-gated | `unity_docs_local` | read | Read one bounded local Unity docs reference returned by unity.docs.query without opening browsers or fetching network docs. |
| `unity.docs.query` | Feature-gated | `unity_docs_local` | read | Search bounded project-provided local Unity docs using the local cache when available, otherwise approved docs roots, without network access. |
| `unity.editor.installations.list` | Feature-gated | `sgg_mcp_diagnostics` | read | Discover installed Unity Editor executables from Gateway-local CLI, Unity Hub, and configured environment roots without accepting arbitrary model-provided paths. |
| `unity.process.list` | Feature-gated | `sgg_mcp_diagnostics` | read | List bounded Unity-related processes with parsed project ownership and heartbeat correlation. |
| `unity.process.terminate` | Feature-gated | `sgg_mcp_diagnostics` | destructive | Dry-run or terminate one verified project-owned Unity Editor process by exact PID and canonical project root. |
| `unity.project.open` | Feature-gated | `sgg_mcp_diagnostics` | write | Dry-run or ask-gated launch of one exact Unity project in a discovered Unity Editor installation without closing existing Editors or deleting project caches. |
| `unity.project.open_status` | Feature-gated | `sgg_mcp_diagnostics` | read | Check whether a requested Unity project is already open in an Editor and whether it has an MCP heartbeat before issuing project-scoped commands. |
| `unity.relay.status` | Feature-gated | `sgg_mcp_diagnostics` | read | Read diagnostic-only official Unity relay availability without launching it. |
